blocks.title: Grants
blocks.text: Processing Foundation offers grants and mentorship opportunities that support the people who build Processing. These grants offer paid pathways into open-source contribution by compensating time, knowledge, and experience while helping developers expand their skills through hands-on projects.

items.title: The Open Source Software Microgrants Program
items.body: The Open Source Software Microgrants Program supports the completion of narrow-focus projects that strengthen the infrastructure behind p5.js. Each microgrant provides $500 for approximately 10 hours of focused work, creating low-barrier opportunities for contributors to make meaningful improvements while receiving compensation for their expertise.

items.title: pr05 Developer Grant
items.body:
The pr05 (pronounced "pros") Developer Grant nurtured early- and mid-career developers deepening their craft in open-source contributions. Participants tackled infrastructural and technical challenges across the Processing and p5.js ecosystems by building libraries, improving workflows, and modernizing the codebase. 
The program concluded in 2025, having supported a generation of developers who helped shape the future of Processing and p5.js.
